title: Text: DET Courtney Foyt ↔ Anthony Fenech

content.text: Sorry for the delay. Are you free like tues or wed next week like 6ish?
Oh thanksgiving is next week!
Completely forgot about that. So I think I’ll be downtown just Monday for work. Maybe the week after?
No worries, I can also come out that way on Tuesday
I have fam out there
“Out there” lol
Everything’s a half hour away
For real. You’re in Allen Park, right?
Yeah, but don’t worry about that. I’m trying to get the ball moving on this so sooner is better than later
Tonight might be ok then. I was kind of worried about it being a bit late, but I am prob going to be working late anyway. Would you be able to come closer to shores?
Yeah, that’s cool
You ever been to Boat Works?
Nope
It’s close to 12 & harper if you’d want to meet there?
Yeah, that’s fine. Let’s say 8ish, but I’ll text you when I’m done with dinner
Ok sounds good
Saturday/sunday would be open too if tonight doesn’t work
Bring your “notes” if you get a chance to grab them
Ok
Heading that way
You still up for it? Just double checking
Stay put. I’m so sorry. We had all our Black Friday assets rejected and I’m still working
I need to gtfo of this place
No worries
Are you free this weekend?
No, but I can come your way early next week?
That works. Sorry I got caught up in work. Hope you didn’t come too far
No I didn’t. Didn’t even get on 94
Agh ok. Have a good night. How was dinner? Where did you go?
Just green dot. Met with two people for this story, if I didn’t say so earlier
Ahh didn’t know it was story related. That’s solid though
It was pretty good. I’m getting close to overkill on the ticket end, though, maybe

My new theory is that leadership doesn’t want to make any severance payments so they’re just making it so terrible to work there that you quit. They started with tickets sales and now they moved on to marketing 😂
There’s a lot of shit I’m trying to wrap my head around
